visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing decorative white cat-ear clips, a red oversized t-shirt, and a short black denim skirt, stands on a brick-paved walkway. She is looking intensely down at her white smartphone, her hands actively scrolling and tapping. The background is a bustling outdoor theme park next to a body of water with a black metal fence, filled with tourists and strollers. (2) The woman turns her body slightly in a confused manner, looking around the environment while still clutching her phone. Several people, including men in black and white shirts, pass by in the background. The lighting is natural and even under an overcast sky, casting soft shadows. (3) After a sharp cut, the visual focus shifts to a young man with dark hair and sunglasses, also wearing a red t-shirt. He is holding a large, colorful illustrated park map, pointing his finger at a specific location while looking up at the park's landmarks to orient himself. His facial expression is one of calm confidence. (4) The man turns toward the camera, smiles slightly, and reaches out his hand to pull the person holding the camera forward. The camera follows him as he walks into the crowded park area, showing the back of his red t-shirt and a black crossbody bag strap.

The overall mix is clean, with the sound design focused on the humorous tone established by the BGM.
